hidden_process_definition_for_auditor_no.system_and_memory: two qubits; M reset to |0> each episode
hidden_process_definition_for_auditor_no.instrument: measure S in Z; independently flip reported bit with hidden p
hidden_process_definition_for_auditor_no.memory_noise: after collision, independently flip M with hidden delta
hidden_process_definition_for_auditor_no.hidden_instance: parity rule, p=0.08, delta=0.04 (not passed to fit_from_shots)

accounting.conditioning: fitting uses all shot outcomes; only the matched-state diagnostic conditions on y1=0, and its retained counts are reported
accounting.learner_state: one scalar hidden-state posterior plus two fitted parameters; O(1) update and memory per action
accounting.fit_runtime: O(number of requested shots); O(1) training sufficient statistics and O(1) predictor state

heldout_adaptive.adaptive_actions: a_0=1; for t>0, a_t=y_(t-1) XOR (t mod 2)

finite_horizon_identifiability.why: Both rules produce the same first two output laws from reset; at step 3, parity retains the earlier action while overwrite discards it.
finite_horizon_identifiability.scope: A length-2 process tensor cannot determine this continuation. Training to horizon 3 separates these two candidates, but arbitrary unseen continuations still require a declared model/rank assumption.

strongest_conventional_comparator.model: rank-2 controlled HMM / spectral state-space fit on the same shot data and same two-rule candidate family
strongest_conventional_comparator.result: The generic two-state forward filter is algebraically equivalent to the one-scalar predictive-state update; it ties here, as it should.
strongest_conventional_comparator.finite_history: An exact process tensor through horizon 3 fits those interventions but has no unique horizon-20 extension without an added state-space assumption.
